tagline: Enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future with technology leadership in electrification and automation.
hero_kpi_rationale: Operational EBITA of $5.4 billion, up 20%, reflects ABB's operational excellence and ability to generate value in a complex macroeconomic environment, supported by improved industrial efficiency and price repositioning.

kpis.name: Adjusted operating profit
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit, excluding non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Operational EBITA reached $5.427 billion, up 20% at comparable rates, reflecting improved industrial efficiency.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in operating margin, a sign of solid execution.

kpis.name: Orders received
kpis.explanation: Total value of new orders signed during the year.
kpis.description: Orders amounted to $33.818 billion, down 1% year-on-year, but up 3% at comparable rates.
kpis.signal: Stable orders despite a challenging macro environment.

kpis.name: Order backlog
kpis.explanation: Value of unfulfilled orders at year-end.
kpis.description: Order backlog reached $21.567 billion, up 9%, driven by demand in automation and electrification.
kpis.signal: Backlog growing strongly, a positive indicator for future revenues.

kpis.name: Revenues
kpis.description: Revenues reached $32.235 billion, up 9%, or 14% at comparable rates.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by price increases and demand.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin is estimated at approximately 38.5%, up 1.6 points, driven by price increases and industrial efficiency.
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement得益于 price repositioning.

kpis.name: Research and development investments
kpis.explanation: Annual expenses dedicated to research and development.
kpis.description: R&D expenses amounted to $1.3 billion, stable compared to the previous year, supporting innovation in automation and electrification.
kpis.signal: R&D maintained at high level despite cost pressures.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain and expand production capacity.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures amounted to approximately $800 million, stable compared to 2022.
kpis.signal: Moderate Capex, consistent with a mature industrial model.

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time employees at year-end.
kpis.description: ABB employs 107,900 people, up 3%, supporting organic growth and innovation.
kpis.signal: Headcount increasing, a sign of expansion in key markets.

kpis.name: Women in senior management
kpis.explanation: Share of women in senior management positions (Hay grades 1-7).
kpis.description: The share of women in senior management reached 21%, up 3.2 points, exceeding the 20% target.

ai_positioning.summary: ABB is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its automation and predictive maintenance solutions, particularly within the Robotics & Discrete Automation division, without making AI a central pillar of its strategy. AI is used to optimize machine and industrial process performance.
evidence: Focus on artificial intelligence in Robotics & Discrete Automation division
AI work in machine automation and factory automation
AI used in predictive maintenance and digital twin applications
